title: This Moth Hears 300 kHz, Fifteen Times Higher Than You Can

scenes.text: This moth can hear sounds fifteen times higher than you can.
Humans top out around 20 kilohertz, and less as we age.
The greater wax moth responded to 300 kilohertz, the highest hearing ever recorded in an animal.
Dolphins stop near 160. Bats can't beat it either.
Scientists think it evolved to catch the ultrasonic calls of bats hunting it.
So the best ears on Earth belong to a moth.
